verdict.rationale: Vercel's Privacy Notice documents a first-party Team Preferences control to "Opt-out of Model Training", tied to Section 3 of the Terms of Service, which directly lets users stop their data being used for AI training. The evidence is a single legal-page mention, not in-depth product documentation. missing for 10: detailed docs on the opt-out's scope and default state (which data and products are covered, e.g. Vercel Agent or AI Gateway traffic), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the setting works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Your Team Preferences allow you to: Opt-out of Model Training as described in Section 3 of the Terms of Service.
Customers can learn about how to control the use of their information for AI product training here.
